spans.s: DAŚ, v. दंश् DAṂŚ.
DĀS, Ⅰ. P. dā́sa, (V.) only with abhi, 🞄bear ill-will to, persecute.
daśa-grīva, m. ten-necked, ep. of 🞄rāvaṇa.
dáśa-gva, a. consisting of ten.
daśát, f. decade.

dáśa-taya, a. (ī) tenfold, consisting 🞄of ten divisions;
 ī, f. pl. the texts of the ten 🞄Maṇḍalas of the Ṛg-veda.

dāśataya, a. (ī) tenfold;
 belonging 🞄to the tenfold Ṛg-veda.
daśa-ti, f. decade.

daśa-daśin, a. consisting of repeated 🞄decades;
 -diś, f. sg. the ten quarters.
daśa-dhā́, ad. in ten parts, tenfold.
dáśan, (also án), a. pl. ten.
dā́śa, m. fisherman, boatman, ferryman, 🞄sailor.
daśa‿ardha, a. pl. five.
daśārha, m. Kṛṣṇa: pl. N. of a people.
daśā‿ālambin, a. hanging down 🞄with the skirt = dragging.

daś-ín, a. tenfold;
 m. lord of ten villages.
daś-era-ka, m. pl. N. of a people.
dāśera-ka, m. fisherman: pl. N. of 🞄a people.

dāseraka, m. (young) camel;
 ī, f. 🞄female camel.
daśa‿īśa, m. ruler of ten villages.

daṣ-ṭa, pp. (√ daṃś);
 n. bite.
dasmá, a. working wonders, marvellous.

das-rá, a. working wonders;
 m. N. of 🞄on of the Asvins.
dāśa-pati, m. chief of fisherman.
dāśarath-i, m. pat. N.: du. Rāma 🞄and Lakṣmaṇa.
dāśa-rājñá, n. battle of the ten 🞄kings.
dāśārṇaka, a. (ikā) belonging to 🞄the Daśārṇas.
dāś-úṣ-e, d. of dāśvás, (pf. pt. of 🞄√ dāś), pious.
dāsī, f. female slave: dāsyāḥ putra, 🞄m. son of slave (also as a term of abuse).
dāsī-kṛ, enslave.

dās-yâ, m. bondage, servitude;
 service, 🞄work of slaves.
